_comment: Golden set for the extract_task capability.
Every case is a sentence someone might actually type, with the smallest
assertion that would catch the capability getting it wrong. Fields left
out are not checked, which is deliberate: over-specifying turns a golden
set into a change detector that has to be edited every time anything
`now` is the instant the sentence was typed, so relative dates resolve.
Deadlines are ISO-8601 UTC and are compared exactly.
CI runs these against the deterministic parser, which is what ships.
tool/run_goldens.dart runs the same file against any backend, which is
how a model gets measured before anything is routed to it. The WP-6 gate
is 80%: below that, the model is worse than the parser it would replace.
Some cases fail today, on purpose. A set trimmed to only what already
passes is a change detector, not a measurement - and the gate is a pass
rate precisely because 100% was never the bar. A failing case here is a
description of a real gap; see STATUS issue 13.
